title: const_cast UB in flash_test_make_rsa_keystore_from_der
description: test/wp11_test_pkcs11.c line ~1275: 'entry.der_bytes = (uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)der;' casts a const uint8_t* to mutable uint8_t* and stores it in wp11_key_entry_t. wp11_keystore_create currently only reads der_bytes, so the UB doesn't manifest, but the cast is latent UB if the encoding path ever adds a write. Fix: either (a) change wp11_key_entry_t.der_bytes to const uint8_t* and propagate through encode_cbor_payload, or (b) in the test helper, allocate a local mutable copy of the DER and use that. Option (b) is simpler since this is test-only code.
